verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line naming a 'Gemini AI assistant in Gmail', a first-party AI assistant that implies natural-language interaction within one app. Nothing documents what commands it accepts or whether it can operate the product beyond Gmail. Apps Script, the Admin APIs and the APIs Explorer are code or low-code tools, not natural-language operation. Missing for 10: documentation of natural-language command capabilities, coverage across Workspace apps and admin tasks, examples of actions performed via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
